runpod.note: Self-hosted RunPod-serverless models (Flux-TTS-S2T, qwen-image-gen/edit). Concurrency is gated per-endpoint (COUNTER#runpod:*), not by this global limit; account-wide worker cap is 10 (20 post-$200).

image.basic.t2i.note: T2I standardized on self-hosted Flux Klein 4B (Flux-TTS-S2T mode:image) across all project types.

image.explainer.t2i.note: Explainer/educational/advertisement/documentary/product-promotion T2I — self-hosted Qwen-Image-Gen. Replaces ERNIE-Image-Turbo (2026-07-21): these 5 genres generate text-free images now (StoryStudio, since 2026-07-11) — on-screen text is composited afterward as an animated Remotion overlay onto the frame's rendered clip (docs/quartermaster/remotion-overlay-lambda-integration-handoff.md), because diffusion-rendered text smudges once the still frame is animated into video. ERNIE's dense-EN-text strength is no longer the deciding factor for a model that never renders text at all, so this tier now uses the same plain t2i model already used elsewhere rather than keeping a dedicated text-rendering endpoint alive.
Explainer T2I fallback — Google nano-banana. Plain t2i fallback (no longer needs any special text-rendering strength — see the primary rung's note).

image.premium.t2i.note: T2I standardized on self-hosted Flux Klein 4B. (Also the movie-basic image t2i via alias.)

image.narrationBasic.t2i.note: Narration Basic image T2I — self-hosted Flux Klein 4B (Flux-TTS-S2T mode:image).

image.narrationBasic.i2i.note: Narration Basic image I2I — Flux Klein 4B with reference_images (Flux-TTS-S2T mode:image).

voice.narrationBasic.tts.note: Narration Basic TTS — self-hosted Kokoro-82M (Flux-TTS-S2T mode:tts engine:kokoro).

image.narrationPremium.t2i.note: Narration Premium image T2I — Flux Klein 4B on flux-tts-s2t. StoryStudio always sends a character reference (→ i2i on qwen-image-edit); reference-less premium frames (scene shots) land here rather than qwen-image-gen, which is held at 0 workers (fleet.ts). Re-point to qwen-image-gen + raise its workers only if a dedicated premium t2i model is needed.

image.narrationPremium.i2i.note: Narration Premium image I2I — self-hosted Qwen-Image-Edit (qwen-image-edit endpoint).

voice.narrationPremium.tts.note: Narration Premium TTS — self-hosted Qwen Voice Design (Flux-TTS-S2T mode:tts engine:qwen). No external fallback for now — Google TTS (gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview) is reserved for the UI-facing voice.premium.tts ladder, not wired here as DR; also wouldn't carry a cloneArtifactUrl/voiceUrl clone through anyway (see runpod.ts).

voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedQwen.note: 4lang localized TTS for Narration Basic projects — same physical Qwen Voice Design/clone rung as voice.narrationPremium.tts, split into its own key purely for billing/audit attribution (mirrors bgm.narrationBasic/bgm.narrationPremium). Since 2026-07-10 the ASL (pipeline-stack.ts localizationStates) sends a per-language cloneArtifactUrl resolved by StoryStudio (voice.narrationClone.pt per language, per qwen-voice-clone/docs/voice-catalog.json) — the clone_artifact_url fast path (runpod.ts) fires the same as the primary QMGenerateTTSClone leg. Qwen has no Hindi voices at all (voice-catalog.json: every es-es-*/pt-br-* entry is a Qwen clone; every hi-in-* entry is Kokoro), so only es/pt-BR realistically route here. webhookCompletion:true (2026-07-25) — this rung synthesizes the WHOLE translated script in one call (not per-frame), which can genuinely exceed any single Lambda's wait window; RunPod's async webhook completion (executor.ts) + the SFN's waitForTaskToken (pipeline-stack.ts ttsTask()) replace the old blocking-poll-in-one-Lambda path that timed out at 850s for both es/pt live 2026-07-25.

voice.narrationPremium.ttsLocalizedQwen.note: 4lang localized TTS for Narration Premium projects — same rung as voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedQwen, split for billing/audit attribution only.

voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedKokoro.note: 4lang localized TTS for Narration Basic projects. `fixed` is now a FALLBACK, not a hard override (changed 2026-07-10, runpod.ts) — an explicit params.voiceId + params.language (sent per-language by pipeline-stack.ts localizationStates, resolved to lang_code via runpod.ts's KOKORO_LANG_CODE map) take priority, so this one rung can serve any Kokoro-backed language, not just Hindi. hf_alpha/lang_code=h (Kokoro's Hindi pack) is loaded on this pod despite the handler's voice-list comment only documenting American/British English — verified live 2026-07-08 (Whisper round-trip kept full meaning, minor phonetic drift on 2 words). Spanish/Portuguese Kokoro voices (ef_*/pf_* per kokoro_voice_reference in qwen-voice-clone/docs/voice-catalog.json) exist upstream but are NOT yet verified on this pod or sampled into the product voice catalog (used_in_catalog:false) — if a Basic project sends a voiceId for es/pt-BR expecting Kokoro, that path is untested until someone runs the same verification Hindi got. webhookCompletion:true (2026-07-25) — see voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedQwen's note; same whole-script-in-one-call duration risk applies to Kokoro.

voice.narrationPremium.ttsLocalizedKokor.note: 4lang localized TTS for Narration Premium projects — same rung as voice.narrationBasic.ttsLocalizedKokoro (including the fixed-as-fallback behavior), split for billing/audit attribution only.

bgm.narration.note: Narration BGM (both tiers) — self-hosted ACE-Step on the dedicated bgm-s2t endpoint (6apg6j7suzuezw, ENDPOINT_ROLE=audio), split off flux-tts-s2t so once-per-project BGM never steals workers from the per-frame pipeline.

srt.narration.note: Narration SRT (both tiers) — self-hosted Whisper large-v3-turbo on the dedicated bgm-s2t endpoint (6apg6j7suzuezw, ENDPOINT_ROLE=audio), split off flux-tts-s2t.

video.narrationBasic.animate.note: Narration Basic animation — Flux-TTS-S2T animate (smooth Ken Burns), replaces the jittery local i2v render.

video.narrationBasic.merge.note: Narration Basic per-frame audio merge — Flux-TTS-S2T merge (animated video + TTS voice).

video.narrationBasic.pipeline.note: Narration Basic one-shot per frame — Flux-TTS-S2T pipeline mode (image -> Kokoro TTS -> animate -> merge in one call, models resident in VRAM). Replaces 4 separate QM jobs/frame. caption:false + no bgm (SRT + BGM are project-level). Internal-only: no external one-shot equivalent, and basic is 100% flux-dependent anyway (animate/merge are flux-only), so no DR is lost.

video.narrationPremium.concat.note: Narration Premium video extension — Flux-TTS-S2T concat, duplicates a single Wan2 clip (video_urls: [url, url]) to cover TTS audio longer than Wan2's 7s max duration_s, before merge trims it to the real audio length. Internal-only: no external DR equivalent, but this only fires for the rare >7s-narration frame, not the hot path.

video.premium.i2v.note: Premium video I2V — self-hosted Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B 4-step Lightning (RunPod nd7wloyvj09xwy). Aspect ratio inherits from the input image.

movie.premium.image.t2i.note: T2I standardized on self-hosted Flux Klein 4B. Was nano-banana-2 (higher quality, now DR fallback) — re-promote if movie-premium image quality regresses.
